title: Feedback record
description: One piece of feedback about HITLd, recorded by `hitld feedback` in the consuming project's private store as feedback/FB-<n> (design part 18.4). It holds the person's own words and the project's IDs, so it is confidential and is refused anywhere but the private store. Publishing it is a separate, approved step. A filed record carries the issue's URL in `url` and the person's approval in `approval`; a withheld one carries the reason in `reason`. Only the generalized `draft` is ever published. A withheld record can take a new draft. Records of schema version 1 (area, version) are read in the new names until the next minor release.

hitld_version.description: The HITLd version (was version before schema version 2).

harness.description: The harness and its version. A version the core cannot learn offline is the string "unknown".

loop.description: The loop or command concerned, from --loop or taken from the refs (was area before schema version 2).

refs.description: Dispatch, decision, item and ledger event IDs the feedback is about.

what_happened.description: A short account drawn from the ledger entries for the refs. Absent when none were found.

expected.description: What the person expected, when they said it.

evidence.description: The ledger entries for the refs, one compact line each.

url.description: The filed issue's URL. Only for filed.

reason.description: Why the record was withheld. Only for withheld.

draft.description: The generalizer's public version of the record, as checked by `hitld feedback draft`. Only the draft's text is ever published. Present for drafted and filed records, and for a withheld one whose draft was caught.

classification.description: The generalizer's classification of the draft. Only a public draft is filed.

approval.description: The person's approval, made by the send gate from their answer in the main session. Present for a filed record, and for a drafted one approved to post by hand.
